$comment: How each agent of .agents/agents/ is graded. gradedBy names the skills whose procedure and report the agent's output is held to: the skill the agent runs, or, when it runs no single one, the skill that defines and judges what it returns. verify:agent-context fails an agent with no entry, an entry with no gradedBy, and a gradedBy naming a folder of .claude/skills/ that holds no SKILL.md.
